name: Date Us, You Won't!
source:
You're at the University's annual festival and somehow got dragged into participating in a dating booth. Since you're here now, might as well go for the ride, right?

Join our wacky OCs for silly jokes and simple chit-chat in Date Us, You Won't !

[From [url=https://wildwildnt.itch.io/date-us-you-wont]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在参加大学一年一度的庆典，却不知怎么被拉进了一个约会摊位。既然来都来了，不如顺势体验一下，对吧？

在《Date Us, You Won't!》中，与我们古灵精怪的原创角色一起，讲讲傻乎乎的笑话，轻松聊聊天吧！

[摘自[url=https://wildwildnt.itch.io/date-us-you-wont]Itch.io[/url]]
